units.source_text: 其中最感到痛心的人，就是西美昂。

en.t: The one who felt the deepest pain over it was Simeon.

units.source_text: 西美昂既同情罗连被驱逐，又生气他欺骗自己，

en.t: Simeon pitied Lorenzo for being driven out, but he was also angry that Lorenzo had deceived him.

units.source_text: 于是在罗连仓皇离开教堂的时候，在门口等着他给了他一拳，

en.t: So when Lorenzo hurriedly left the church, Simeon waited for him at the entrance and struck him with his fist.

units.source_text: 罗连受到痛击扑倒在地，然后自己勉强站了起来，

en.t: Lorenzo was hit hard and fell face down on the ground, then managed to get back to his feet by himself.

units.source_text: 满目含泪，长叹一口气祷告：“主啊！

en.t: With tears filling his eyes, he let out a long sigh and prayed, Lord!

units.source_text: 恳请您饶恕西美昂，他不知道真相才会这样的。”

en.t: Please forgive Simeon; he acted this way only because he does not know the truth.

units.source_text: 西美昂听到这话顿感怅然，

en.t: When Simeon heard these words, he was suddenly overcome with melancholy.

units.source_text: 只能呆呆的站在门口，对着空气挥舞自己的拳头。

en.t: He could only stand blankly at the entrance, swinging his fist at the empty air.

units.source_text: 众兄弟百般劝说，他才放下手，

en.t: Only after the brothers pleaded with him in every way did he lower his hand.

units.source_text: 但一直沉默不语，脸色阴郁。

en.t: But he remained silent the whole time, his face dark and gloomy.

units.source_text: 据当时在现场看见的人说，当时暴风快来了，

en.t: According to those who saw it there at the time, a storm was about to come.

units.source_text: 罗连在寒风中垂头丧气，向着长崎西空夕阳残照中踽踽而行，

en.t: Lorenzo walked alone through the cold wind, his head bowed in dejection, toward the afterglow of sunset in the western sky over Nagasaki.

units.source_text: 少年优雅的身影略显萧条，就像置身于火焰中一样。

en.t: The boy's graceful figure looked somewhat desolate, as though he were standing amid flames.
